_comment: Account-wide subscription tiers. Loaded ONCE by setup-catalog.php, not per solution. Recurring billing is deferred (Bagisto core has no native recurring) — these publish as catalog entries showing the monthly price; the annual price is in the description. Wire a subscription extension before relying on auto-charge. See ADMIN_DOCS.md.

tiers.name: Membership — Individual
tiers.short_description: For consultants and individual admins. Access to all published solutions, guides, and scripts.
tiers.description:
Individual — $499/month or $5,988/year

  • Access to all published solutions
  • Download implementation guides
  • Download PowerShell scripts
  • Solution updates
  • Monthly new releases

tiers.name: Membership — Professional
tiers.short_description: For MSPs and small IT teams. Everything in Individual plus commercial use rights and source files.
tiers.description:
Professional — $999/month or $11,988/year

Everything in Individual, plus:

  • Commercial use rights
  • Internal company use
  • Download source files
  • Solution templates
  • DevOps work item templates
  • Assessment frameworks

tiers.name: Membership — Enterprise
tiers.short_description: For enterprises. Everything in Professional plus enterprise licensing, governance, and priority support.
tiers.description:
Enterprise — $1,499/month or $17,988/year

Everything in Professional, plus:

  • Enterprise licensing
  • Multiple administrators
  • Internal training rights
  • Enterprise governance packages
  • Priority updates
  • Call Now / Fix Doc Now
  • Architecture templates
